title: Canonical CXR Ontology
description: Schema for the canonical chest-radiograph classifier ontology after YAML-to-JSON parsing. JSON Schema cannot verify that category and parent identifiers resolve, that identifiers are globally unique, or that the parent graph is acyclic; those constraints require a separate semantic validation pass.

schema_version.description: Version of this serialization schema, independent of the ontology content version.

description.description: Scope and intended use of the ontology.

parent_semantics.description: Meaning of class parent edges and the required propagation behavior.

categories.description: Organizational groupings only; category records are not image-classifier labels.

classes.description: Complete set of intended image-classifier outputs. Identifier uniqueness, reference existence, and graph validity require semantic validation beyond JSON Schema.

id.description: Stable snake_case category identifier; class category references must resolve to one such identifier.

description.description: Organizational scope of the category and any important exclusions.

id.description: Stable snake_case class identifier, unique across classes.

category.description: Identifier of an organizational category. Reference existence requires semantic validation.

parents.description: True semantic is-a or label-inheritance parents only. Every identifier must resolve to another classifier class; organizational grouping belongs in category. Existence and acyclicity require semantic validation.

kind.description: Semantic role of the classifier output.

dataset_mappings.description: Mappings to each audited source dataset. Empty arrays explicitly mean no useful mapping.

puccxr.description: Mappings to PUCCXR labels, preserving source spelling and capitalization.

cxrlt2024.description: Mappings to CXR-LT 2024 labels, preserving source spelling and capitalization.

vindr_cxr.description: Mappings to VinDr-CXR labels, preserving source spelling and capitalization.

preliminary_definition.description: Concise medically careful description of what is visible or predictably inferable on chest radiography.

notes.description: Explicit caveats concerning hierarchy, propagation, projection, ambiguity, or annotation.

mapping.description: One semantic mapping to a source class.

class_name.description: Source class name with exact source capitalization.

relationship.description: Relation of the source class to the canonical class: exact/near equivalence, or source broader, narrower, or partially overlapping.
